purpose: Prevent blocked, queued, provider-gated, target-host-gated, stale or failed dependency lanes from being promoted into global runtime failure unless continuing would violate a proven safety, integrity or semantic invariant.

CORE_MANDATORY.required_behaviour: Stop only the operation whose semantic validity depends on the dependency.

CORE_DEGRADED.required_behaviour: Continue with reduced but valid functionality.

OPTIONAL.required_behaviour: Bypass the feature and continue the runtime.

EXTERNAL_GATE.required_behaviour: Continue locally while external proof remains pending.

REPLACEABLE.required_behaviour: Select another adapter, provider or execution plane.

DEFERRED_COMMIT.required_behaviour: Persist work and reconcile it when the dependency returns.

runtime_domains.blocked_domain: self-hosted macOS ARM64 runner / launchd / iostat evidence
runtime_domains.continuation_mode: continue Ubuntu-portable execution; keep M3 proof pending
runtime_domains.re_entry_condition: matching self-hosted runner executes and uploads evidence artifact
runtime_domains.retry_policy: workflow rerun or runner pickup when available
runtime_domains.circuit_breaker_policy: do not endlessly retry inside portable runtime
runtime_domains.rollback_policy: no rollback of portable runtime required

runtime_domains.fallback_path: versioned update bundle, append-only ledger and replayable outbox
runtime_domains.continuation_mode: produce mirror receipt and replay package locally
runtime_domains.re_entry_condition: mirror host becomes reachable and integrity checks pass
runtime_domains.retry_policy: replay on next healthy mirror host check
runtime_domains.rollback_policy: preserve previous mirror state until receipt verifies

runtime_domains.fallback_path: reconstruct milestones from append-only task evidence
runtime_domains.continuation_mode: continue task execution with local receipts
runtime_domains.re_entry_condition: monitor reads and verifies accumulated receipts
runtime_domains.circuit_breaker_policy: do not block task receipts when monitor is stale
runtime_domains.rollback_policy: preserve receipt ledger as source of truth

runtime_domains.continuation_mode: computation, storage, display, agent execution and scheduler remain healthy
runtime_domains.circuit_breaker_policy: disable audio adapter until health probe succeeds

runtime_domains.fallback_path: local receipt, outbox and deferred provider envelope
runtime_domains.continuation_mode: continue local runtime and mark provider proof pending
runtime_domains.retry_policy: provider retry only when credential and network gates exist
runtime_domains.circuit_breaker_policy: do not claim remote provider state without receipt
runtime_domains.rollback_policy: provider state not promoted until verified
